test_all_expr: test the pl.all() expression to select all columns from a DataFrame including null values
test_any_expr: test the pl.any() expression to check if any boolean value in a column is true
test_alias_for_col_agg_bool: test that pl.all() and pl.any() module-level functions are aliases for col().all() and col().any()
test_alias_for_col_agg: test that pl.min(), pl.max(), pl.sum(), pl.cum_sum() are aliases for their corresponding col().method() calls
test_mean_overflow: test that pl.mean() handles large datasets without overflow for both int and float32 schemas
